problem: The displacement $s,$ in meters, relative to a fixed origin $O$ of a particle moving in a straight line along the $x$-axis is given by $s(t)=\sqrt{t}\,\operatorname{ln}⁡t,$ where $t>0$ is the time measured in seconds. Determine the time intervals in which the particle is moving in the direction of decreasing $x.$

activity_context.topic_title: Determining Characteristics of Moving Objects Using Differentiation
